scope: Three selected S124 storage outcomes; current source diff and current before/after browser evidence

findings.finding: Dark and light captures are byte-identical within each device/state in reports/s124-after-browser.json. The harness changes documentElement.dataset.theme but leaves body.dataset.theme intact. Product applyTheme sets both, and the stylesheet matches either, so the theme matrix does not prove distinct themes.
findings.requiredFix: Use the product applyTheme API or set both root/body theme attributes, assert their resolved values and computed colors, recapture true dark/light before and after images while preserving the original source identity of each baseline.
findings.resolution: Product applyTheme now sets root/body; all dark/light captures visually differ and are readable. Independently verified both attributes in four viewport/theme controls.

findings.finding: The selected tutorial outcome explicitly requires applied-receipt dismissal under denied/quota storage in desktop/mobile and both themes. Existing browser evidence only clicks Skip Tutorial.
findings.requiredFix: Exercise all three actual choices, return an authoritative fixture receipt once, verify the applied receipt, then dismiss without reapplying. Cover getter denial and throwing storage methods, both viewports/themes.
findings.resolution: Corrected matrix captures applied receipt in all four viewport/theme combinations and asserts dismissal. Independent controls completed real three-step UI with one callback and zero overlays after dismissal.

notes: Shared browserStorage access catches SecurityError before default argument evaluation reaches each of the six modules.
Injected storage objects and franchise key derivation remain unchanged.
Return-boundary writes now return false when a writer is unavailable.
Tutorial storage methods are independently guarded. Completion continues to require an onComplete receipt with effects.
Contextual receipt write failure leaves the panel and draft, renders role=alert, and returns before onSaved/completion. A subsequent successful write closes the panel.

visualInspection.baselineLimit: Baseline six affected modules are routed from git9d87b5ec in the inspected harness; remaining modules are current. Baseline is a hybrid fault fixture, not a complete historical deployment.
notes: Before tutorial skip remains open after quota failure; before completion shows Quota exceeded and retry instead of an applied receipt.
Before feedback retains draft without an error; after shows a clear not-saved retry message.

Both themes have readable text and controls. Mobile after receipt and feedback controls fit within viewport. Baseline mobile failed completion requires dialog scroll; it is an original failed state, not a new candidate defect.
